claims.title: A diagonal sum with a tridiagonal summand is not a universal n4 Horn normal form
claims.statement: T4 fails for alpha=(3,-1,-1,-1), gamma=(3,1,-1,-3), and beta the ordered roots of x^4-16x^2+8x+16. A=J-I and B=Dgamma-A certify feasibility. Every tridiagonal matrix with spectrum alpha is a shifted rank-one projector supported on at most two coordinates, forcing B to retain at least two of 4,2,0,-2. None is a root of the target polynomial. This excludes all 24 permutations and also complex Hermitian tridiagonal candidates. Closedness implies nearby feasible all-simple counterexamples.
claims.domain: The supplied T4 normal form; no restriction of simultaneous unitary tridiagonalization alone.
claims.note: Exact certificate and independent proof review with reused evaluator. No numerical solver failure used as exclusion evidence. No explicit perturbation radius, new universal constructor, or novelty claim.

claims.title: Fixed cubic-parameter quartic completion has compact convex planar slices
claims.statement: For p=x^4+a(y)x^2+(b0(y)+s phi(y))x+c0(y)+phi(y)(t+uy), phi=y(y^2-1), fixing s gives a compact convex completion set in (t,u). After the global derivative real-rootedness test, exact halfplanes come from the quartic critical values; an empty slice has at most three scalar halfplanes witnessing infeasibility. Derivative-admissible s values form a compact interval, possibly empty.
claims.domain: Real a,b0,c0 of degree at most two; all finite real y; repeated roots included.
claims.note: Independent proof review and exact symbolic identity checks. No novelty claim, fixed finite sampling rule, global s selector, feasibility certificate-size bound, or algorithmic termination result. The projection of the full completion set onto s is not proved an interval.

claims.title: Direct sign conversion from three-dimensional singular-value sums to Hermitian Horn is false
claims.statement: The proposed universal conversion preserving all three singular lists by independent eigenvalue signs and permutations fails. Input lists (3,2,1),(3,2,1) and output (3sqrt(2),2sqrt(2),2) have an explicit real left-right sum realization, but every signed input trace is integral and every signed output trace is irrational. The original real n4 additive realization has simple input and output spectra.
claims.domain: Direct sign and permutation conversion preserving all three singular lists; real symmetric or complex Hermitian target matrices.
claims.note: Independent exact review with an alternative magic-basis ordering. No novelty, global inverse obstruction, or exclusion of auxiliary-variable reductions asserted. General endpoint-selection frontier unchanged.

claims.title: Conditional fixed LR-chain orthogonal reconstruction
claims.statement: Under the note's simple intermediate spectra, specified common roots, strict residual gaps, positive overlap weights, interlacing and trace guards, orthogonal rank-three lifting of a supplied LR spectral chain is equivalent to three rational spectral equalities. Backward and forward residue reconstruction supplies the directions when they hold.
claims.domain: Only the explicit strict supplied-chain domain in rank3-coupling.md.
claims.note: Algebra independently reviewed, but no independently runnable general reconstruction certificate or project-level theorem promotion. No selection or coverage of endpoint triples; no novelty claim. Derivation audit of user-supplied proposal, not a preregistered generic solver attempt.

claims.statement: Plain real scaling returns five of twelve frozen additive n4 witnesses; spectral block assembly plus scaling returns seven. Independent 6000-sweep wall22 replay matches error 0.007344222724209537; its block reconstruction passes.

claims.title: Direct parabolic metric pilot solves its discrete equation but fails the realization gate
claims.statement: On one frozen simple-spectrum feasible rank-four input, all three predeclared finite-domain metric levels converge to row-scaled PDE residuals below 5.4e-12 and produce orthogonal determinant-one frames, but original-target root errors are 1.0264312, 0.8073789 and 0.6500450, exceeding the 1e-4 pilot gate. Independent peripheral transport and large-loop checks also fail the requested spectra and loop closure.
claims.domain: Exactly R0386 fixture.json, fixed real flag bases, prototype.py and the three stored truncation/logarithmic-grid levels. Finite numerical observation; no stable-seed, continuum or universal route exclusion.
claims.note: Practical NO-GO for this direct pilot; broader parabolic machinery is not refuted. All72 QLR rows have positive slack (minimum0.12498), a rational separator witnesses a genuinely stronger degree-one bound, and the chosen logarithm norm sum is1.62pi.
